name: chat_model_picker_search_and_favorite
goal: On Chat screen, open the model selector sheet, type a search keyword, toggle favorite star rapidly, clear search, and verify smooth rendering without stale counts.

name: chat_drawer_folders_and_history_search
goal: Open Chat drawer, scroll conversations, open move-to-folder or history/search page, verify items render cleanly.

name: provider_add_models_immediate_refresh
goal: Precondition: a Mock provider with models must be configured (see README pre-flight). Open Settings -> Providers, select a provider, tap Add Model (+), add a model, verify it appears immediately without exiting and re-entering.

name: qiniu_icon_and_non_chat_tags
goal: Open Qiniu provider (qiniuyun), verify provider icon is Qiniu logo (not letter Q), and verify embedding/image-edit models do not display TOOL or REASONING badges.

name: provider_batch_remove_dialog
goal: Precondition: a Mock provider with models must be configured (see README pre-flight). In Provider Model List, filter models, verify Batch Remove appears, open confirmation dialog, and cancel cleanly.

name: setting_model_capability_editor
goal: Navigate to Settings -> Model -> Capability Editor, verify compact TopAppBar and editable override list.

name: assistant_detail_extensions_and_memory
goal: Open Assistants -> select an assistant -> navigate to Extensions and Memory subpages, verify compact TopAppBar and memory add dialog scrolls cleanly.

name: extensions_prompt_and_lorebook
goal: Open Extensions -> Prompts -> Lorebook tab, open an entry editor, verify form fields and back navigation.

name: skill_detail_tester_ime_avoidance
goal: Open Extensions -> Skills -> select a skill -> open Tester sheet, tap input field to show soft keyboard, verify input stays above keyboard.

name: skill_catalog_sources_sheet
goal: In Skills page, open Skill Store and Manage Sources sheets, verify status row is not clipped at the bottom.

name: workspace_files_and_editor
goal: Route: Extensions -> Workspace -> select a workspace -> Files tab. Open Extensions -> Workspace -> select a workspace -> open the Files tab and verify navigation. Stay on the Files tab once there; do not revisit other tabs.

name: setting_network_dns_proxy_tunnel
goal: Open Settings -> Network -> visit DNS, Proxy, Host Overrides, and Tunnel subpages, verify compact TopAppBar and tunnel bottom sheet scrolling.

name: setting_mcp_and_search_detail
goal: Open Settings -> Search Service -> open a search provider detail page via the card's overflow menu (⋮) -> Edit, verify compact TopAppBar and form layout. Only pass after the search provider detail page is visible (its 'Test Search' section must be on screen); do not pass from any other page.

name: setting_speech_tts_and_asr
goal: Open Settings -> Speech / TTS, switch between TTS and ASR tabs, verify bottom sheet height and drag handles.

name: setting_vault_credentials
goal: Open Settings -> Vault, tap Unlock, enter the 6-digit PIN 123456, tap CONFIRM, then verify list layout and add/search controls.

name: setting_scheduled_jobs_and_workflows
goal: Open Scheduled Jobs and Workflows, open a detail page, verify compact TopAppBar and cron summary rendering.

name: setting_backup_s3_and_webdav
goal: Open Backup page, visit each tab exactly once (S3, then WebDAV, then Import/Export), verify scroll and form fields. Once a tab is verified, pass immediately without switching back to an earlier tab.

name: app_log_json_tree_light_dark
goal: Precondition: a Mock provider must be configured and at least one request must be logged (see README pre-flight). Open App Log / Request Log page, open a log detail bottom sheet containing JsonTree in light theme, verify syntax colors are high-contrast and readable.
